descriptions.g5c_trim_regions_802150b0: Trims external runtime heap regions after consolidating pending blocks through80213f98. Applies the original non-direct guard, walks saved next-region links, detects a free tail through its boundary flag/backlink, unlinks it from the size tree or small-bin chain, and invokes release slot4 of the observed80400768 callback table. Recomputes remaining tail size after a successful release and returns any remainder to its pending-size bucket. Clears the guard and returns zero; an active non-direct guard returns minus1. All heap, region and variable block accesses are external32-bit metadata views; no local aggregate or initialized data is owned. Names and trimming roles are inferred.
